purpose: AI-readable native lifecycle, persistence and external-source lookup contract

fields.zh: 每个订阅回调内惰性快照
fields.rule: fresh for next subscriber; recapture after destructive mutation within the same callback

fields.zh: 夜间只保留身份并逐台重新解析
fields.en: resolve each nightly candidate from the live graph
fields.rule: slot/run/day attempt marker persists; consumed candidates are skipped

fields.zh: 默认拒绝含内部物品材料；显式整图消费
fields.en: Reject by default; explicit ConsumeGraph for nested materials
fields.rule: whole-root consumption; failed preflight has no debit

fields.en: resolve current-run source on every callback
fields.rule: static delegates retain resolver rules, never loaded native wrappers

fields.zh: 仅同步批次内借用源对象
fields.en: borrow source only inside synchronous transaction
fields.rule: Validate/Verify read-only; Debit at most once; Restore actual source idempotently

fields.zh: 只读ES3文本，不等于原生对象恢复
fields.en: read-only ES3 parsing is not object restoration
fields.rule: separately compare actual saved fields and a true new-process load

test.testTools: temporary native observation/close helper; removed before final cold load; excluded from release

limitations: vanilla furnace nested material/old-output policy still incomplete
